comment: Dr. Nethersole is sweet but extremely oblivious. No one pays attention in class, participates, or reads the books. She is so helpful outside of class, but most of the time I spent in class I felt like I could be doing something better. She's not great at running discussions, which is what she attempts to base the course on. Midterm was easy.

Very oblivious- everybody just on their laptops while she goes on about the readings. Quite a few books to read, but sparknotes come in clutch. Get a general idea of the books and the midterm, essay, and one short presentation will be easy. Should be a really easy class but hard to stay motivated haha

Nethersole is a terrible teacher. I honestly have no idea how she is qualified to teach college students. She just has absolutely no idea how to teach a class. I often left class feeling dumber than when I walked in. Towards the end of the semester I used class as a study hall to do work for my other classes so that was nice I guess.

She is oblivious. Everyone was on their laptops the entire time - on Facebook, etc. An extremely boring class. She relied on repeating nonsensical phrases that were loosely connected to the text/curriculum. At the end, I didn't even know what I could have learned in the class.

An ok teacher. incredibly boring. Definitely the occasional language barrier since she is SA. Seems to lack qualification for the class and relies entirely on repetition of whats said in the large amount of reading she assigns. Occasionally confuses herself. Grading is almost as random as class discussions. horrible with names, yet plays favorites.
Nethersole is awesome! She is the sweetest woman I have ever met. She is a very very reasonable grader! Really wants students to participate in class, very helpful!
Prof. Nethersole is great, she really cares about the kids and isn't bad at all.  Your lucky if you have her for CORE.

Reingard is from South Africa, and even though English is her native language, there is a language barrier in her class.  You can get by without reading, but i found that when I did read, there is a significant improvement in both grade and understanding (go figure).  She is a fairly easy grader, but its pretty hard to get an A on papers.

This lady is the sweetest ever! She tries so hard to make the class interesting and varied, but there is only so much you can do with core. If you get her, you are exteremely lucky because she is the best core teacher by far!
best profesor at UR. Hands down.
Harder than advertised and boring as all hell but she's easy to deal with.

dont have to do the reading if you go to class. very very easy grader. easiest core teacher based on complaints ive heard. she is so nice and always willing to help you and very understanding of excuses for extensions. you cant choose your core teacher but fi you get her consider yourself really lucky.
Great teacher, she's funny cuz she's so odd but I like her.

She is like a grandmother and reminds me of M off James Bond. She looks like her and has the accent (South African).  She is a fair grader.  She requests the name to be but on the back page so she doesn't know who wrote it until after she grades it.  Use blackboard for participation points. Class discussions aren't on a certain topic and scattered.

interesting class.. pretty easy class, fair grader, but sometimes the discussions have absolutely nothing to do with the text. its a pretty funny class. Nethersole is possibly the nicest lasy i've ever met.
Didnt like her style
This lady has no idea what is going on, the lectures are totally unintelligeable.  She is a tough grader but will help you a lot outside of class.  Overall a bad teacher but a really nice person
very nice, very concerned, and extremely fair.

Such a nice lady, and soooo cute. She really wants her students to be interested and do well. You kind of have to do lots of work outside the class in order to do well though. She's a tough grader but is really helpful when you go for help. You get out what you put in.
a bit oblivious to what's going on, so pretty easy
